speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Go. The middle is not going to widen because you are fond of a doorway.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Beans when you are back. I have said beans. I am still saying them.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The arch first. Then beans. He said the middle, and a middle has an arch in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The middle. Come, the three of you. The knife is in the belt, and the book is in her hand.
